scientific.integrity: The infinite complete-multipartite classification is proved directly. Exhaustive enumeration through order nine is used only as a regression check. Originality is supported by targeted literature comparison with explicit residual bibliographic risk.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The finite checker is corroboration only; the arbitrary-order statement rests on the symbolic proof.

title: Locating-total domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
